resolve_placeholders: resolve double-brace placeholders in args dict using completed events return values
create_event_action: create an EventAction model with app_name, class_name, function_name, args, and operation_type fields
create_completed_event: create a CompletedEvent model with event_id, event_type, event_time, action, and return_value
create_oracle_event: create an OracleEvent model with event_id, event_type, action, args, resolved_args, and return_value
create_judgment_result: create a JudgmentResult model with success boolean, agent to oracle event ID mapping, and failure_reason
